description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notice of Amendment under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, that Excise Duty on Permit Issued; published in Gaz. Ex. Nos. 2044/32 & 2058/34
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of excise duty regulations under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989. It contains legal/regulatory changes to duty structures and permit requirements, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions Minister Mangala Samaraweera, this is only in his capacity as the authority making the regulatory changes, not as a personnel appointment with detailed portfolio responsibilities. The core content is regulatory amendment rather than government structure or personnel matters.
